messages:
alice: kicking off RC creation for v2.19.0 — build artifacts uploaded to gs://redwood-releases/v2.19.0/rc-20260321
DeployBot: RC candidate created: rc/v2.19.0-20260321-1 (artifact sha: abc123def)
ben: ack. quick check — any db migrations or feature flags to flip?
carla: no DB migrations. feature flag is behind a gate (ff/new-routing = off). only config + tokenizer tweak. QA ran perf and smoke on staging, all green.
pm_omar: tagging for release notes and customer-impact blurb. @sre_liz can you take sheriff for the promo window (15:30 PT)?
sre_liz: I can cover 15:00-18:00 PT. I'll add the tracing spans and latency SLOs to the watchlist: latency.p50, latency.p95, error.rate. Set alert if error.rate > 1% or latency.p95 > 200ms.
alice: added checks to promo checklist. also added a rollback play: revert traffic and pin back to rc/v2.18.9 if anomaly. command snippets in checklist:
```
# rollback to previous RC image
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=registry/redwood:v2.18.9 -n prod
# or use deploybot: /deploy revert rc/v2.19.0-20260321-1
```
ben: good. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 1min steady windows between steps. manual pause if any alerts.
DeployBot: Pin request submitted for rc/v2.19.0-20260321-1. awaiting approver sign-off.
pm_omar: signed off (pm_omar). pin approved. scheduling promotion at 15:30 PT.
DeployBot: Promotion scheduled: 2026-03-21 15:30 PT. Canary plan: 5% (5m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (monitor 20m). autoscale and KV warm enabled.
carla: starting KV warm now with replay traffic from canary dataset. smoke tests running.
DeployBot: pre-promo smoke check: PASSED. readiness probes stable.
ben: GO from eng/releases side if SRE and PM are good.
sre_liz: GO from SRE. I'll watch for error spikes and tail latency.
pm_omar: GO from PM.
alice: initiating promo -> starting canary 5%
DeployBot: Canary 5% promoted at 15:30:12 PT. telemetry: error.rate 0.12%, latency.p95 +8ms. no alarms.
ben: holding 5m, look for resource surge.
carla: seeing normal CPU bump, KV hit-rate steady.
DeployBot: advancing to 25% at 15:36:20 PT.
ben: moving to 25% -> monitor for QPS saturation and token cost regression.
DeployBot: Canary 25% stable. error.rate 0.18%, latency.p95 +12ms. all thresholds OK.
ben: advancing to 100%
DeployBot: Promoting to 100% traffic at 15:50:05 PT. rollout complete. note: replica count autoscaled to handle latency p95 targets.
carla: posting release notes update: https://confluence.redwood/release-notes/v2.19.0 (includes model config details, rollout plan)
alice: leaving rollback tag just in case: git tag rollback/rc-v2.19.0-20260321-1 -> pushed
sre_liz: minor perf blip observed at 15:42 PT but recovered within 60s; documented in post-rollout notes. no follow-up actions required.
pm_omar: closing loop — release published, customers notified via announcement channel. great work team :tada:
ben: adding final checklist entry: monitor for 24h, then promote stable tag and remove canary guard.
carla: thanks all :thumbsup:
